description: ADR-0555 conversion pin (FRIC-1781330000): unreachable is baseline-block-on-new in the armed (post-merge-base-advance) configuration. A PR adds a NEW file no live registry points at (not under a workspace member, not mentioned in masterplan/root-hub/doc-catalog, not covered by a reviewed specs/reachability-registry.json entry); the settle regen carries it into both current and proposed. Against the frozen merge-base reference it is a compare-mode regression (FAIL) AND un-signed-off ratchet growth; the grandfathered unreachable debt stays tolerated.

unreachable.remediation: register the path in a reachability registry (masterplan / root-hub / doc-catalog / specs/reachability-registry.json) or place it under a workspace-member crate
